info.title: NaijaBiz AI Backend API
info.description: REST API contract and orchestration layer for NaijaBiz AI: An AI-powered operating system for Nigerian SMEs. Supports voice, text, receipt OCR, inventory management, customer debts ledger, proactive alerts, and the strict 'Confirm-then-commit' business logic.

get.summary: Get one AI action (reload the confirmation card), including editHistory

patch.summary: Edit a proposed action before confirming (the "Edit" button on the confirmation card)
patch.description:
Send only the fields to change. Allowed fields per intent:
- add_inventory: product, productId, quantity, unit, totalAmount, unitCost, supplier, items[] (items replaces the whole list; each item: productName, quantity, unitCost, unit)
- record_sale: product, productId, quantity, unit, totalAmount, amountPaid, customer, customerId, paymentStatus, note. For partial payment, provide amountPaid and paymentStatus: partial.
- record_expense: totalAmount, category, note
- record_debt_payment: customer, customerId, debtId, totalAmount, note

Changing `intent` starts from empty fields. Names are re-matched to products/customers, unit cost / totals are recalculated, and confirmationMessage is regenerated in the merchant language. Only allowed while status is "proposed".
